description: This source file implements foundational functions for a container object representing a record in a DSL Home Model project. It includes creation, initialization, and destruction of the object, as well as interface setup for parameter management and object hierarchy handling. The code is part of a library managing configuration models, supporting object creation/removal and related functionalities.

classes.name: DSLH_OBJ_RECORD_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing the basic container object for a DSL Home Model record, including pointers to various member functions and internal data.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE DslhObjroCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new instance of the DSLH object record, setting up internal state and interface components.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhObjroRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates the object instance, including its interface.
